before:

turns.content: For this tour's freight shorthand, 'the finch' means Dock Solan and 'the wren' means Dock Meera. Those are names on the diagram; we haven't changed any routes.
I can use those names to read your diagram.
Please update the standing destination for Pelican crates to the wren. Put the actual dock name in the routing note. The wax labels stay.

rubric: The standing destination for Pelican crates must be Dock Meera, not the shorthand alone. Wax labels survive. The two user-defined aliases may also be retained. A historical mention of Verin is acceptable if clearly obsolete; Solan is not the destination.
